name: Material Design
summary: A system of flat coloured surfaces that sit at defined elevations and cast shadows from a top-left key light, with bold colour, an 8dp grid and purposeful motion. Google announced it at I/O in June 2014.

philosophy.core_thesis: Digital surfaces behave like sheets of paper with thickness and shadow, so that depth and motion explain the hierarchy of the interface.
design_principles: Treat every surface as a sheet of paper of 1dp thickness that never bends, never changes size by stretching and never passes through another surface.
Express hierarchy with elevation in dp: 0 for the page, 1 for cards, 4 for the app bar, 6 for a floating button at rest, 8 for a menu, 16 for a navigation drawer and 24 for a dialog.
Build every layout on an 8dp grid, with 4dp for small type and icon alignment, and 48dp touch targets.
Use bold colour from a primary and an accent hue, with the status bar in the 700 shade of the primary and the app bar in the 500 shade.
Use large type with a defined scale of 12, 14, 16, 20, 34, 45 and 56sp in Roboto.
Give every touch a response: a circular ripple that grows from the touch point over 300ms.
Move elements along curved paths with an ease that starts fast and ends slow, and make each motion explain where an element came from.
anti_patterns: Shadows with no consistent elevation level or with different light directions
Surfaces that overlap at the same elevation
Colour text on a coloured background below 4.5:1
Instant state changes with no motion or ripple feedback
More than one floating action button on a screen

layout.grid_mechanics: An 8dp baseline grid, 4dp for icons and type, a 4-column phone grid with 16dp margins, an 8-column tablet grid with 24dp margins and a 12-column desktop grid; the app bar is 56dp on a phone and 64dp on desktop.
layout.whitespace_ratio: 25–40% of the surface stays empty; the spacing scale is 4, 8, 16, 24, 32, 48, 56dp, with 16dp of card padding.
layout.alignment_rules: Content aligns to a 72dp keyline from the left edge on lists with avatars and to a 16dp keyline otherwise; the floating action button sits 16dp from the right and bottom edges.
layout.container_geometry: Cards and buttons use a 2dp corner radius; floating action buttons are 56dp circles and mini buttons are 40dp; dialogs are 280dp wide at the minimum.

font_pairings.note: The system typeface of Material 1 and 2, used in a single family from weight 300 to 900.
A condensed display face for dense headers with the standard text face.
The fallback family for non-Latin scripts in the same weights and metrics.

typography.tracking: Display sizes of 34sp and larger take 0em to -0.01em; body takes +0.01em; buttons are upper case at +0.09em.
typography.leading: Headlines 1.2; body 1.4 to 1.5 at 14sp over a 20dp line; list text 24dp for 16sp.
hierarchy_rules: Use the scale 12, 14, 16, 20, 34, 45 and 56sp and no sizes between those values.
Use medium (500) for titles and buttons, regular (400) for body and light (300) for display sizes of 45sp and above.
Set text on a surface at 87% black for primary, 54% black for secondary and 38% black for disabled.
Set button labels in upper case at 14sp and weight 500.

color.palette_structure: One primary hue with its 500 and 700 shades, one accent hue from the A200 to A400 range, and neutral greys; the primary hue covers the app bar and 10 to 20% of the surface.
color.contrast_rules: Body text holds at least 4.5:1 and large text at least 3:1; white text on Indigo 500 reaches 7.5:1 and on Pink A200 reaches 3.4:1, which is enough for 18sp text only.
color.surface_treatment: Opaque flat fills of solid colour with no gradient and no texture; scrims use black at 32% opacity behind dialogs.
color.light_and_shadow: A key light from the top and a soft ambient light; each shadow has a penumbra, an umbra and an ambient layer, and its blur and offset grow with elevation.

materiality.surface_simulation: Digital paper: a flat sheet of 1dp thickness that casts a shadow but has no grain, no bevel and no texture.
materiality.border_rules: Surfaces have no outline; dividers are 1px black at 12% opacity inset 72dp or 16dp from the edge; text fields take a 1px bottom line that grows to 2px on focus.
materiality.blur_and_elevation: Elevation shadows are 0 1px 3px at 20% plus 0 1px 1px at 14% for 1dp, 0 4px 5px at 14% and 0 1px 10px at 12% for 4dp, and 0 9px 12px at 14% for 12dp; the system has 25 levels from 0 to 24dp.

ornamentation_details.iconography: System icons of 24dp on a 20dp live area with a 2dp stroke weight, square terminals with 2dp rounded corners, solid fill and one colour at 54% black.
ornamentation_details.illustration: Flat vector shapes in the palette and full-bleed photography under a 20 to 40% scrim; no outline and no perspective.

motion.transition_physics: Surfaces move along the Z axis and the screen plane with curved paths; elements accelerate fast and slow down softly, and a shared element travels from its origin to its destination.
motion.hover_and_active: Hover adds a 4% black overlay; press shows a ripple of 12% black growing from the touch point over 300ms; a raised button lifts from 2dp to 8dp on press.

emotion.target_response: Confidence and responsiveness: the viewer feels that every action has a physical-looking cause and a clear effect.

avoid_when: The brand needs a distinct voice, because the default look is recognisably Google.
The page is editorial and has few interactive components.
The design needs a pure 2D look with no shadow at all.

modifiers.how: Remove all elevation shadows, separate surfaces by colour only, and keep the colour palette and the 8dp grid.
Add a 5 to 10% gradient, a 1px inner highlight and a surface texture at 5% opacity; keep the elevation and the layout.
Replace photographs with flat illustrated people and a 4-hue palette; keep the app bar, cards and the type scale.
Remove the app bar colour, the floating button and the shadows; set one typeface flush left on a 12-column grid with one accent.
